The authors propose a motion-centric probing and evaluation technique that questions previous efforts on motion referring expressions segmentation and can be used to drive better understanding of video MLLMs performance.

### Soundness

3 good

### Presentation

3 good

### Contribution

2 fair

3. The authors propose three strong baselines that outperform the state of the art while being static biased.

1. The proposed method is not novel. The proposed method is just a simple baseline that uses the static keyframe for segmentation.

2. The authors only evaluate the proposed method on the MeVIS dataset. More datasets should be included.
